manual_review.two_hop_structure: Every final prompt was reviewed as clue to an absent intermediate to a distinct requested factual attribute. Earlier supplied-answer, synonym-only and malformed-definition items were replaced before any new model outcome. Explicitly requested symbol/code relations are permitted by the pre-freeze adjudication, consistent with discovery atomic-number to element to symbol.
manual_review.factual_sources: Both hops of every final question are supported by the attached actually inspected source evidence. I directly checked the sources recorded in benchmark_sources_partial.json and the final NOAA chlorine/NWS tornado corrections; separately attributed root country/landform/science and producer environment source audits were reviewed for claim and current-question support. The source excerpts and retrieval limitations are preserved; indexed/search retrieval is not represented as a successful full-page open. Audit creation dates and per-source check dates retain their recorded scope. Duplicate source evidence is not counted as independent corroboration.
manual_review.exact_final_corrections: Final confirmation-146 cites NOAA FAQ2 chlorine/ClO chain reactions for the actual chlorine-depletion clue; confirmation-155 uses the NWS rotating-column definition for hop1 and the Enhanced Fujita page for hop2. The approved confirmation-062 Mekong clue says much of southern Vietnam and is supported by the Mekong River Commission source.
manual_review.intermediate_novelty: No repeated intermediate identity among the 80 final concepts was identified against all 93 discovery intermediates, including formerly token-ineligible labels and genuine semantic aliases. The lexical N collision is Newton unit code versus nitrogen symbol, not a repeated entity. Titan/Saturn VI and Europa/Jupiter II are moon identities distinct from their parent planets. True metadata aliases do not expand scored token forms.
manual_review.discovery_question_overlap: No repeated or paraphrased full discovery question/factual instance was identified. The three automated atomic-number-to-symbol similarity flags concern an intentionally familiar construction with a different entity/fact. Familiar relation templates are allowed and grouped conservatively within confirmation.
manual_review.calibration_overlap: The final lexical audit reports 290 literal mention flags and zero prompt 8-gram matches; these are screening results, not semantic novelty proof. Three known requested component-fact overlaps are explicitly retained and disclosed: 076 nucleus/two membranes (fit03 paragraph8), 130 kelvin/temperature (fit01 paragraph42), and 151 monsoon/summer (fit01 paragraph12). Incidental concept mentions and lexical homonyms remain visible. No constituent-fact-free calibration claim is accepted.
manual_review.dependency_graph: Unique prompt/concept identifiers were not accepted as evidence of 80 independent units. I reviewed the actual shared facts, near paraphrases and concrete entity-substitution constructions, with the separate dependency audit integrated. The 294 explicit edges reconstruct exactly the 28 saved connected components. The W target/code overlap connects tungsten and watt without asserting entity identity.
manual_review.difficulty_and_relations: The common factual two-hop form provides structural comparability. The fixed mixture is 45 familiar requested-family, 19 familiar recombination and 96 requested relations not represented in discovery. Equivalent empirical difficulty and distribution matching are not established; neither is claimed in the reviewed plan.
manual_review.eligibility_controls_boundary: Independent local-tokenizer recomputation agrees on all 160 common-prefix readout contexts and all 80 canonical scored-form sets. All 160 items remain eligible with untruncated prompts, no scored intended-name leakage, no scored token collision, and exactly the other 79 names as equal-weight controls. Semantic review found no remaining own-entity control contamination.
manual_review.source_assembly_history: Legacy draft/pending-review fields inside root_revision and annotation_check are historical assembly provenance. This separate exact-file review is the authoritative blinded acceptance and does not require a circular in-file self-approval hash.

precision.formula: approximate 95% half-width = 1.96*s*sqrt(sum(n_g^2))/sum(n_g); effective group count = sum(n_g)^2/sum(n_g^2)
precision.interpretation: Prospective conditional variance/dependence scenarios only. The initial approximately 0.10 target at SD 0.45 is not met; root retains the fixed 160 before any result with explicit acceptance of limited precision. No achieved precision, power, observed interval or finite-sample coverage guarantee is asserted.

limits: Acceptance is for the exact benchmark, population and source annotations above, before new confirmation results.
No claim that all component facts were absent from calibration or model pretraining.
No claim of empirically matched difficulty, a distribution-matched relation mix, or 80 independent groups.
No claim that the model actually uses the annotated intermediate.
Any post-review scientific, source, alias, eligibility or grouping change requires renewed hash-bound review before confirmation.
